title: A Window To The World
text:
Title: A Window To The World

Some writers begin to write with talent, quickly earn a reputation among readers and critics, 
and then are suddenly silenced forever. We had two such men at the Yiddish Writers’ Club in Warsaw. 
One, Menahem Roshbom, had managed, before he was thirty, to publish three novels. The other, Zimmel Hesheles, 
had at the age of twenty-three written one long poem. Both got enthusiastic reviews in the Yiddish press. 
But then, as the saying goes, their literary wombs closed up and never opened again.
